global_silver_linings.title: Voyager 2 was Running Low on Power Until NASA Engineered a ‘Big Bang’ to Buy Another Year
global_silver_linings.snippet: NASA engineers found a way to free up power aboard Voyager 2, helping the nearly 50-year-old spacecraft continue its scientific work. The Jet Propulsion Laboratory team decided to simultaneously shut down certain powered components and replaced them with options that use less energy—while also making sure Voyager 2 stayed warm enough to function properly. Decaying […] The post Voyager 2 was Running Low on Power Until NASA Engineered a ‘Big Bang’ to Buy Another Year appeared first on Good News Network .
global_silver_linings.reason: Decades into deep space, Voyager 2 is still singing — and the fact that NASA engineers found a creative solution to keep it alive reminds us that human ingenuity and the will to explore have a remarkably long reach. This little spacecraft, now beyond our solar system, continues to send back irreplaceable data because a dedicated team refused to give up on it.

global_silver_linings.snippet: BY THE OPTIMIST DAILY EDITORIAL TEAM You probably already know the feeling, even if you’ve never had a name for it. The way your shoulders drop and relax the moment you step under a canopy of trees. How the breath comes a little easier.
global_silver_linings.reason: Science is now confirming what anyone who has walked quietly through trees already sensed — that time in nature measurably lowers stress hormones and restores the mind in ways little else can. Knowing there's solid research behind it makes it easier to prioritise that slow woodland walk, not as a luxury, but as genuine self-care.

discovery_articles.title: Southernmost ATM in McMurdo Station, Antarctica
discovery_articles.snippet: At the bottom of the world, the world’s southernmost ATM offers an ordinary convenience in one of the least ordinary places on Earth. Located at 77°51′ south, it's the southernmost cash machine in the world—and the only ATM anywhere in Antarctica. The ATM was installed to serve the staff working at McMurdo Station, Antarctica’s largest research base.

discovery_articles.title: James Dalton Trumbo Statue in Grand Junction, Colorado
discovery_articles.snippet: James Dalton Trumbo was a controversial writer who penned quite a few Hollywood films in his era, including Roman Holiday (1953) and Spartacus [960]. He was one of ten left leaning directors and screenwriters that refused to testify before the House Committee on UnAmerican Activities Committees and as a result, was blacklisted. A Colorado native, Trumbo moved to Grand Junction in 1908 from his birthplace in Montrose.

discovery_articles.title: Puente de la Amistad in Ciudad del Este, Paraguay
discovery_articles.snippet: The Puente de la Amistad (Friendship Bridge) connects the cities of Foz do Iguaçu, Brazil, and Ciudad del Este, Paraguay. Built in 1965 as a symbol of goodwill between the two neighboring countries, the bridge offers beautiful views of the Paraná River just miles from the popular Iguazú Waterfalls. Crossing the bridge can feel less like international travel and more like entering an enormous open-air shopping trip.

discovery_articles.title: The Outer Rim in Seattle, Washington
discovery_articles.snippet: The Outer Rim is a sci-fi themed coffee shop in the Magnolia neighborhood of Seattle, boasting fan art spanning multiple sci-fi franchises! Opened in late 2023, The Outer Rim is the passion project of graphic designer Martin Kuenn, combining a clean mid century interior design aesthetic with his collection of sci-fi art. You can admire the unique interior design and lovingly curated collection of art/action figures while enjoying a themed drink, as well as a selection of pastries.

news.title: Broth, tart and salad: Kirk Haworth’s vegan tomato recipes for summer
news.snippet: A smoky tomato broth, a grilled peach, tomato and almond ‘ricotta’ salad scattered with roast almonds, and a sparky tomato tarte tatin August is peak tomato season. This most versatile of fruits can be put to just about any use, from raw to slow-cooked and from oven- or sun-dried to desserts (believe it or not, they go incredibly well with summer berries, especially strawberries and raspberries). Not only that, but tomatoes have high glutamate levels that rise even further as they ripen, which gives them an umami kick.
news.blurb: Kirk Haworth makes a compelling case for August tomatoes across three vegan recipes — smoky broth, a grilled peach salad, and a tarte tatin — that prove peak season needs very little fuss.

fern_data.greeting: Still thinking about the Bacchae, actually — how Euripides wrote madness so precisely it reads less like myth and more like a diagnosis — and today leans into that same unsteady territory, from dystopian novels that turned out to be field guides to whatever the brain is doing when you look away from something and still keep seeing it.
